title: Symptom-anchored label permutation (Petersen 2026)
differences_from_source: Inference uses this library's Freedman-Lane permutation GLM (labels permuted within datasets, 5000 permutations, voxel max-statistic FWE primary, BH-FDR secondary) with a lesion-volume covariate; the source's software and exact settings are not reproduced.
description: Within-cohort case-control design: every dataset holds lesions with and without the symptom, and the group labels are permuted within datasets. A single 2026 preprint; it is not established practice.
